skill.name: code-conventions
skill.description: Guides AI coding assistants to follow Deno formatting and documentation conventions.
skill.summary: Apply Deno formatting and English JSDoc or TSDoc documentation rules.
skill.author: 5t111111

security_audit.summary: The static finding is a false positive. SKILL.md line 13 contains a Markdown inline command reference for a formatter, not executable Ruby or shell backtick syntax.

static_findings.snippet: - Always run `mise run fmt` to format the code before committing

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 13 uses backticks as Markdown inline code around the formatter command. There is no executable script, interpolation, or shell backtick execution in the skill file.

content.value_statement: Teams lose consistency when Deno formatting and documentation rules are unclear. This skill guides agents to format with mise and document symbols in English.
actual_capabilities: Guides agents to run mise run fmt before commits.
Requires documentation comments for functions, classes, and properties.
Provides concise repository convention guidance from one skill file.
limitations: Does not include automated formatter code.
Does not define lint rules beyond formatting and documentation.
Assumes the repository has a mise fmt task configured.
Does not cover testing, release, or architecture conventions.

use_cases.title: Standardize Deno Repositories
use_cases.description: Apply shared formatting and documentation expectations during routine code changes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Check that changed symbols have English documentation before a review.

use_cases.title: Guide AI Coding Sessions
use_cases.description: Give Claude, Codex, or Claude Code concise rules for consistent edits.

prompt_templates.title: Check Basic Formatting
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the code conventions to my current Deno changes. Focus on formatting and documentation comments.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner check before a small commit

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Commit
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this change against the code conventions. Format the project if appropriate and report any missing documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Review Public Symbols
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the changed functions, classes, and properties. Ensure each one has clear English JSDoc or TSDoc comments.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Pull Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this pull request against the code conventions. Separate formatting issues, missing documentation, and assumptions about project tooling.

output_examples.input: Review my Deno change before commit.
output_examples.output: Formatting was checked against the project formatter. One exported function needs an English documentation comment before review.

output_examples.input: Check whether the new class follows the conventions.
output_examples.output: The class needs a TSDoc comment. Its public property also needs documentation in English.
The branch follows the documented conventions after formatting. No missing function, class, or property comments were found.

best_practices: Confirm mise and Deno are installed before relying on formatting output.
Ask for permission before running formatter commands in unfamiliar repositories.
Review exported symbols for missing JSDoc or TSDoc comments.
anti_patterns: Skipping formatting because the change looks small.
Adding undocumented public functions, classes, or properties.
Writing documentation comments in a language other than English.

faq.question: Does this skill run code by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides instructions for an AI assistant. The assistant may run the formatter during a coding task.

faq.question: Which projects does it fit best?
faq.answer: It fits Deno projects that use mise for formatting and require JSDoc or TSDoc comments.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code for AI-assisted repository work.

faq.question: Does it replace a linter?
faq.answer: No. It gives convention guidance and does not define a full lint rule set.

faq.question: What documentation does it require?
faq.answer: It requires comments for functions, classes, and properties. The comments should be written in English.

faq.question: What should I check before using the formatter command?
faq.answer: Check that the repository defines the mise formatter task and that you trust the project scripts.
